name: 德米特里·伊万诺夫斯基
bio_short: 俄罗斯植物学家, 病毒学的先驱之一. 他在1892年研究烟草花叶病时, 发现了通过细菌过滤器后仍具有感染性的病原体 (`ivanovsky_virus_1892`), 从而成为世界上第一个发现病毒的人.
bio_short_en: A Russian botanist and a pioneer of virology. In 1892, while studying tobacco mosaic disease, he discovered a pathogen that remained infectious after passing through a bacteria-proof filter (`ivanovsky_virus_1892`), effectively becoming the first person to discover viruses.
